{category}test_count.short_description: Weekly number of NAAT tests from participating commercial laboratories. National (United States) is the sum of state counts for each week.

{category}positive_count.short_description: Weekly number of positive NAAT tests. Counts under 10 are suppressed by CDC and imputed as 5 (flagged by suppressed_flag). National (United States) is the sum of state counts, so it includes imputed 5s from suppressed states and is approximate.

{category}value.short_description: Weekly percent of NAAT tests that were positive. Where positives were suppressed (<10), it is computed from the imputed count of 5 divided by tests. National (United States) is total positives divided by total tests across states, times 100, so it is affected by state-level suppression.

{category}suppressed_flag.short_description: Equals 1 when tests were performed but positives were suppressed (<10) and imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. NA for national (United States), where some state is suppressed in nearly every week.

bundle_respiratory/dist/rsv_positive_tes.long_description: Weekly number of positive RSV nucleic acid amplification tests reported by NREVSS laboratories in each HHS region, as a centered 5-week moving average (the week, the two before and the two after; fewer weeks at the ends of the series). Computed in the bundle from the weekly counts in delphi_nrevss/standard/data_region.csv.gz. Weekly counts of 1-4 are suppressed by CDC and enter the average as 2.5, the midpoint of that range. The United States value is the population-weighted mean of the ten regions, not the national total.

RSV season, July to June, written as 'YYYY-YYYY'.
bundle_respiratory/dist/rsv_positive_tes.long_description: The epidemiological year runs from MMWR week 27 (early July) to week 26 of the following calendar year. For example, 2024-2025 starts the first week of July 2024 and ends the last week of June 2025.

bundle_respiratory/dist/rsv_positive_tes.short_description: Week of the RSV season, with week 1 in early July.
bundle_respiratory/dist/rsv_positive_tes.long_description: Week of the epidemiological year: MMWR week 27 is epidemiological week 1 and MMWR week 26 of the following calendar year is week 52. Computed as MMWR week - 26 (weeks 27-53) or MMWR week + 26 (weeks 1-26), so in seasons with an MMWR week 53 (2020-2021 and 2025-2026) that week and the following week 1 both have epidemiological week 27; use date or week to tell them apart.

bundle_respiratory/dist/rsv_positive_tes.short_description: 1 where the 5-week average includes a week with no published count (in practice, a count CDC suppressed, filled with 2.5); 0 otherwise.
bundle_respiratory/dist/rsv_positive_tes.long_description: CDC suppresses weekly positive counts of 1-4 in the NREVSS data served by Delphi; those weeks enter the 5-week average as 2.5, the midpoint. The flag is 1 where any week in a region's 5-week window was filled this way, and for United States where any region's value was. Flagged values are estimates. The CDC file used before November 2026 (3cxc-4k8q) was not suppressed.
